title: progressive disclosure
rule: Keep confirmation copy short and offer a way to learn more before commit.
pass_when: Confirmation copy is short; extra detail is available before commit.
fail_when: All extra consequence detail dumped on the first screen, or no way to learn more when extra detail exists.
overview: Confirmation copy stays short, with optional detail available before commit.
apply_when: Writing confirmation dialogs that have extra consequence detail.
not_when: Confirms whose short copy already covers every material consequence.
agent_hint: Keep confirm copy short; link or expand for more detail before commit.
description: Confirmation screens should lead with short copy and offer a path to learn more before commit. Dumping every consequence on the first screen overwhelms; hiding needed detail with no way to open it under-informs. Lead brief, then disclose extra consequence detail on demand so people who need depth can get it without blocking everyone else. If the short statement already covers the risk, skip empty progressive chrome.
